results.title: Fastest animals - Wikipedia
results.snippet: This is a list of the fastest animals in the world, by types of animal.The fastest land animal is the cheetah, capable of running at speeds of up to 93–104 km/h (58–65 mph). Among the fastest animals in the sea is the black marlin, with uncertain and conflicting reports of recorded speeds.

results.title: The Fastest Animals on Earth | Britannica
results.snippet: Whereas the cheetah is the fastest sprinter, the pronghorn, also known as the American antelope, is the fastest long-distance runner of the animal kingdom. It is capable of maintaining a speed of nearly 35 miles per hour over several miles and is even faster over shorter distances.

results.snippet: The peregrine falcon holds the title of the fastest animal in the world, achieving speeds over 240 miles per hour (386 kilometers per hour) during its stoop (dive). This speed is made possible by its streamlined body and strong wings.

results.title: The fast animal in the world - Brainly.in
results.snippet: Fastest bird (and animal overall): Peregrine falcon – in a dive (stoop), it can reach 320–390 km/h (200–240 mph). Fastest sea animal: Sailfish – can swim around 110 km/h (68 mph). So, if you’re asking the fastest animal in the world overall, the answer is the peregrine falcon.
